notes.summary: Independent ink reading of the upright notes and the inverted cancelled draft. All supplied C doubt loci and explicit scan-071 context checks have dispositions. H unreadable placeholders are accounted for at Donnons nous, ce qu’on appelle, the lower parenthesis, and the two internally deleted groups.
notes.math_reading_decisions: Only local symbol comparison was used: the straight first inequality was compared with the bowed second sign, and x/i/I sizes and positions were inspected. No theorem, implication, support assertion or bijection claim was proved or mathematically repaired. The application-like context did not justify supplying an arrowhead.
notes.author_checks: The overwritten capital is retained with alternatives that include mere retracing; no independently legible earlier whole glyph is asserted. The low point at final A_i is assigned to i rather than supplied as punctuation. The corollary’s baseline de is visibly cancelled beneath the raised phrase. Paragraph text appears once in the figure for the inverted draft; ordinary deletion state remains encoded with deleted.
notes.title_dates_pagination: No title or date. Upper number remains 70/79 over 69/79. Lower surface number is 55 with an unresolved earlier second digit 4/3. No neighbouring page number was consulted. The reference is read cf page/pge 67.
notes.framing_limits: The rightmost continuation of inclusion punctuation is incompletely framed in crop 11; its uncertainty is retained. Graphic crop 14 reaches the boundary at source x=1680 around y=1805; the line remains open there and no unseen continuation is drawn. The whole-page view established overall extent. Crop 14 was used only for the distinct still-open boundary/cancellation geometry, not to reopen decided textual loci.
notes.structural_checks: JSON parsed; brace depth was balanced; begin/end environments matched; every crop path existed; boolean fields had JSON boolean types; each remaining-doubt reading or figure reference occurred in reading.tex. No LaTeX compiler or OCR was invoked.
